definition.simple: The plant's food delivery system that carries sugar made in the leaves to the rest of the plant.
definition.academic: A complex permanent tissue in plants that conducts synthesized food (mostly sucrose) from leaves to other parts of the plant.

examples: The sweet sap in maple trees is transported through phloem.

common_misconceptions: Thinking phloem only moves downwards. It actually moves bidirectionally to wherever food is needed.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Phloem starts with the 'F' sound, just like Food! Phloem = Food.
